turns.text: I'm ready to begin! Please let me know which piece to place first and at what position on the grid.
Can you give me some guidance on what our objective is please?

Our objective is to recreate a specific target pattern on the 6x6 grid using the yellow tile with straight black horizontal lines (ID 0) and the other patterned pieces you have in your staging area (pieces ID 0–23). Since I can't see the target pattern, I need you to guide me on which piece to place and where. If you can describe or show the target pattern, I can follow your instructions step by step to match it as closely as possible. What should I place first?
Place the piece in the upper left of the grid on the upper left of the target
I've placed the yellow tile with straight black horizontal lines (ID 0) in the upper left corner of the grid at position (0, 0). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a pink backround and 5 wavy lines directly below the one we have already placed
I've placed the light-pink tile with wavy horizontal lines (ID 1) directly below the piece in the upper left corner, at position (0, 1). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a yellow background and 4 black lines crossing in an aterix shape, below the one we have just placed
I've placed the yellow tile with a starburst of rays around a centre dot (ID 15) directly below the pink piece with 5 wavy lines, at position (0, 2). What would you like me to do next?
Place thepeice that is a gird of back lines on a white background to the right of the first piece we placed
I've placed the cream tile with a thin crosshatch diamond grid (ID 11) to the right of the first piece, at position (1, 0). What should I do next?
Rpleace the first piece that we placed with the spiral

I've replaced the first piece in the upper left corner with the pale-pink tile with a single thick, bold black spiral winding counter-clockwise (ID 7). The light yellow horizontal striped piece has been moved back to the staging area. What should I do next?
The spiral is incorrect. Use the spiral that is in the upper left, with a thinner line spiral, that starts on the right of the shape, and initially moves upwards and to the left.
